fixes.description: Add None guard before accessing discount.discount_value
fixes.why_this_fixes_root_cause: Prevents TypeError when discount lookup returns None for unknown codes
fixes.unified_diff:
--- a/src/cart/pricing.py
+++ b/src/cart/pricing.py
@@ -42,7 +42,8 @@ def apply_discount(cart, code):
     discount = lookup_discount(code)
-    total = cart.subtotal - discount.discount_value
+    if discount is None:
+        return cart.subtotal
+    total = cart.subtotal - discount.discount_value
     return total
manual_review_notes: Verify no other callers of apply_discount expect exception on bad code
